title: Chapter 438
paragraphs: Chapter 438
Episode 126. Someday, when you have forgotten, like an unforeseen disaster (1)
Five days had passed since the banished and the knights attacked Tikan.
But with only knights appearing, the 12th generation has yet to show any significant movement, leaving the elders feeling increasingly uneasy day by day.
In a villa of the Elder Council in the city of Calon, Jorden and his elders sat around a round table, their faces dark and frustrated.
In front of them were piles of newsletters from various countries covering a recent incident.
Tikan Free City, attacked by unidentified assailants.
Some facilities and equipment were destroyed, but it was reported that there were no casualties...
Tikan Free City Defense Force turned into an army of iron, about Jin Runcandel.
As proven during the Sword Emperor Castle incident, the 12th generation Runcandel has something extraordinary in responding to terrorism.
It's not that the 12th generation is particularly outstanding, but rather a virtue that naturally comes with being a Runcandel...
Injured 12, dead 0! All terrorists killed, the dignity of the Free City.
Not long after the Sword Emperor Castle terror, why are terrorists rampant these days?
The identity of the terrorists has not yet been revealed... What kind of response will the 12th generation show?
The front page of the newsletter was filled with content about the Tikan terror. Not only in Huphester, but also in Vermont and some newsletters from the Lutero Magic Federation.
Some of the elders looking at the newsletters sighed.
In fact, they all wanted to sigh, but they held back while watching the trembling Jorden, who was enraged. Only high-ranking elders had the privilege of sighing.
"Not... a single death...!"
Jorden roughly clenched the newsletter in front of him and shouted. His bloodshot eyes were filled with dark anger.
"What a disgraceful situation!"
Bang!
Jorden's fist shattered the round table, sending fragments flying in all directions.
When they decided to send the banished to Tikan, Jorden never expected this outcome.
Although it was impossible to completely destroy Tikan, at least a catastrophic level of civilian casualties and the lives of several of Jin's colleagues were expected.
With two banished and a group of at least seven stars involved in the terror, it was not at all excessive to expect such damage.

"It's an unbelievable story, Elder Chairman. Even if they were incompetent, they should have had hundreds of civilian casualties, or rather, that's too few. There should have been at least a thousand civilian casualties."
"Please calm down, Elder Chairman. Here, have some cold water to drink. Look! Bring some colder water!"
"It's clear that the banished have betrayed us."

"Why on earth did they betray us? Their goal is revenge. They know the power of the Black Sword Association better than anyone, and they certainly wouldn't have rated the 12th generation higher than the Elder Chairman."

"But if it's not betrayal, then how do you explain the results? Besides, these articles are based on information that the 12th Squad intentionally leaked to the press. It even means there's a high possibility that the claim of all the exiles and nobles being dead is a lie."
"Then, wouldn't it also be possible that the claim of no casualties in Tichin is also a lie?"

"Do you still say that after experiencing the 12th Squad? That devilish guy would never do anything disadvantageous to himself. It's an issue that would clearly reveal the truth if investigated thoroughly, and the damage to Tichin has already been verified by other agencies from various countries."
"Ah, seriously. The 12th Squad. The fact that the audacious perpetrator who took the lives of the elders last time hasn't made a move yet is making me even more anxious."
The elders, who were speaking back and forth, were all staring at Jorden's lips.
Depending on the decision he makes, the incident could either be covered up or escalate.
Jorden's rough breathing, like the sound of scraping metal, gradually grew shorter. He was barely suppressing his anger.

"… I understand everyone's concerns. The 12th Squad, that crazy perpetrator, may be quiet now. But we can't just let it pass. Like when they took the lives of the elders last time, they will surely retaliate."
As Jorden opened his mouth, the elders' expressions darkened once again.
Some of them secretly thought Jorden had 'lost his touch.' He had boasted about going to war with the 12th Squad, but from the very beginning, the outcome was disappointing.
"What should we do then, Elder?"
"Last time, the acting head of the family said something that's been bothering me. If we disappoint them one more time, they'll temporarily shut down the Council of Elders…"
"Ah, get rid of such pessimistic thoughts!"
At those words, Jorden put his hand on his forehead.
"First, the Black Sword Association…"
As Jorden was about to answer, they heard someone running in the hallway.
"Elder, we're in big trouble!"
It was a guardian knight of the Council of Elders.
From his desperate attitude, twisted expression, and anxious eyes, Jorden and the elders couldn't help but be engulfed by a sense of foreboding.
It seemed like the 12th Squad had probably started their retaliation in earnest.
"What's going on? Calm down and tell me."
Jorden's eyebrows trembled slightly as he tried to ask calmly.
"The exiles… They've come to the Garden of Swords!"
At the guardian knight's answer, the elders couldn't help but let out a deep sigh from the bottom of their hearts.
"Get a carriage ready right now!"
In December, at the height of winter, an absurdly heavy downpour was falling.
The guardian knights guarding the Garden of Swords looked up at the sky more often than usual due to the strangely gloomy and peculiar weather.
It seemed as if the sky was weeping in sorrow.
"It's like night even though it's daytime. What kind of rain is falling like this?"
"On days like this, it's just depressing. When it ends, we should have a stiff drink…"
The chatty gatekeeper knights straightened their posture and closed their mouths, as they saw a knight clad in shining gray armor approaching from a distance.
The gray armor signified that he was a knight who enforced the family's laws.
A rank that all guardian knights of the family aspired to and respected, along with the black helmet.
The guardian knights saluted with tense expressions.
The enforcement knight returned the salute courteously, and the gate leading to the Garden of Swords opened.
The guardian knights did not lower their saluting hands until the enforcement knight disappeared from sight.
"Indeed, the atmosphere is different from that of ordinary guardian knights, starting with the enforcement knights."
"But wasn't the armor he was wearing just now an old-style enforcement knight armor? I think I saw it in a textbook during my rookie days."
"Was it? I'm not sure. We don't get to see it often... I wonder if we'll ever get to wear that armor someday."
The gatekeepers had no idea that he was a knight who had been purged long ago.
Even if the armor was old-fashioned, they thought there was no way someone would be crazy enough to forge Runcandel enforcement knight equipment and impersonate them.
Especially not in Huphester Calon, the Garden of Swords.
"It's because not just anyone can wear that armor that we show such respect."
Clank, clank, clank.
Mud and water were stepped on by the exile's feet.
The exceptionally heavy soaked cloak felt like the weight of the time it took to return here.
The 12th Squad was right.
Damaging Rosa's authority and shouting the truth while dying gloriously was the best revenge they could take.
'Why couldn't I think of such a simple idea before?'
The exiles knew the answer.
It was because their desire for revenge was directed at 'Rosa Runcandel,' not Runcandel.
If they enter the Garden of Swords as they are and reveal their survival, Rosa will undoubtedly suffer a significant blow.
However, that was not the end.
The price of loyalty and devotion to the family was this horrible exile and purge, and if the other knights found out...
It was an issue that could sufficiently shake the entire Runcandel.
They fiercely denied it, but the exiles had always loved Runcandel even after their purge. Some might laugh at their twisted loyalty, but they didn't care.
Their brightest days were undoubtedly bound to this land.
- As the 12th Squad said, it's indeed the only revenge we can take. But what we're seeking is not just against Rosa but threatening the entire Runcandel.
- That's true.
- The family's unity will weaken, and it will be an opportunity for large forces like the Zipfel. Don't you know that?
- Is that the image of Runcandel you want?
- What did you say?

- A dirty and weak family that would be devoured by enemies if they didn't hide their rotten smell doesn't seem like the Runcandel you want. Anyway, the choice is yours. Whether you'll die or reveal the truth.
Suddenly, the conversation he had with the 12th Squad before finding the Garden of Swords came to mind.
'If the 12th Squad had been born a little earlier, we would have become his knights. We could have maintained our honor until the end.'
With each step, they relished the Garden of Swords they had built themselves while suppressing the overwhelming regret.

They paused for a moment, looking at the countless swords embedded around the garden, and when they encountered the familiar faces of old servants and scribes, they recalled their names in their minds.
Just as they thought the scenery hadn't changed at all since before their exile, they saw ongoing repair work in progress on one side.
'Is that the 12th Squad's work?'
It was the sight of the central arena that had been shattered during the 'Family Declaration'. The exile stood there for a moment, imagining how fierce and incredible the battle that day had been.
The raindrops that slipped indifferently into the armor were cold.
The exile stopped walking again when he reached the courtyard right in front of the main house.
Gradually, gazes gathered toward the exile, who was standing tall and looking up at the high place of the main house. Everyone began to feel that his behavior was unusual.
'Why is the enforcement knight standing still like that?'
'Was there an enforcement knight who still wore the old-style armor these days?'
Amidst the passing people who were growing more suspicious one by one.
The exile shouted at the person who would be above the main house, the person he had hated so much.
With a voice as huge and deep as thunder.
"Knight Rosa Runcandel, come out and listen to our story!"
